title: 第10章 不能猜测的背景
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
从这里出发往隔壁山头走，对面山脚底下有个带温泉的山洞，非常适合居住，顺带还能泡一下温泉。

    以前他们没地方住的时候，都是去的那里。

    “这……不用了三师兄，我也跟小师妹在这里吧，我看这里风景不错。”

    说着，濮阳明珠从储物戒里拿出一个跟微生璃月有些相似的法宝，轻轻往那座庞大的宫殿旁一扔，一座小很多的四合院就出现在眼前。

    陆明薇：……

    林不语：……

    亏他俩还担心这两人没地方住，敢情两个小师妹都是有钱人，就他们这几个师兄师姐是穷鬼啊！

    因为剑峰灵气突然暴增匆匆赶来观察情况的慕鹤云，看到眼前出现的庞大宫殿，双眼睁得老大。

    师祖啊，这宫殿的灵气浓郁度，怕不是炼了好几条极品灵石矿脉。

    讲真的，要不是对自己的实力有认知，慕鹤云都想贪了。

    “这……明薇啊，这是你们小师妹弄出来的？”

    不敢直接问大小姐，慕鹤云只得向还处于震惊当中的陆明薇询问，得到的是人家呆愣的点头。

    随后赶来的各峰长老，正巧听到了两人的对话，再看看眼前这个比他们太虚宗主殿还要气派的大殿，麻了。

    微生大小姐到底是哪个家族出来的败家子，连一个普通住所都豪横，那可是极品灵石，极品灵石诶。

    不用来修炼就算了，居然用在这种地方。

    还有没有天理，有没有王法，有没有道德，有没有途径，他们也想进微生家做个客座长老了。

    “那个……师侄啊，不知道你是出身哪个修仙世家，师伯以前怎么从来没有听过微生家的传闻？”

    看着那一块块镶嵌在墙壁上的极品灵石，慕鹤云实在是好奇他这位师侄的背景。

    虽说他们太虚宗所在的青云洲域地方有些偏，可他也没听说过八十一洲域里有哪个修仙家族是姓微生的。

    其余长老闻言，纷纷竖起耳朵，他们也很好奇。

    大小姐行事如此嚣张，必定是来自极其强大的家族。
content_en:
From here, walk to the next mountain. There is a cave with hot springs at the foot of the opposite mountain. It is very suitable for living. You can also take a bath in the hot springs.

They used to go there when they had no place to live.

"This... no need, Third Senior Brother, I will stay here with my Junior Sister. I think the scenery here is pretty good."

With that said, Puyang Mingzhu took out a magic weapon that was somewhat similar to Weisheng Liyue from the storage ring, and gently threw it next to the huge palace, and a much smaller courtyard appeared in front of her.

Lu Mingwei:......

Lin Buyu:......

Fortunately, they were worried that they would have no place to live. They were both wealthy, but they were the only ones who were poor!

Mu Heyun, who rushed to observe the situation because of the sudden increase in Jianfeng's spiritual energy, opened his eyes wide when he saw the huge palace appearing in front of him.

Master, the spiritual energy in this palace is so rich that it must have been refined from several veins of top-quality spiritual stones.

To be honest, if Mu Heyun didn't know his own strength, he would be greedy.

"This...Mingwei, is this done by your junior sister?"

Not daring to ask the eldest lady directly, Mu Heyun had no choice but to ask Lu Mingwei, who was still in shock, and received a blank nod.

The elders from various peaks who came later happened to overhear the conversation between the two, and looked at the hall in front of them, which was even more impressive than the main hall of their Taixu Sect, and felt numb.

Miss Wei Sheng is a prodigal from which family. She can even live in an ordinary residence. That is a top-grade spiritual stone. A top-grade spiritual stone.

Even if it is not used for cultivation, it is actually used in such a place.

There is also whether there is heavenly law, whether there is king's law, whether there is morality, and whether there is a way. They also want to join Wei Sheng's family and become a guest elder.

"Um...nephew, I don't know which family of immortal cultivators you are from. How come my uncle has never heard of the rumors about the Weisheng family before?"

Looking at the top-quality spiritual stones inlaid on the wall, Mu Heyun was really curious about the background of his nephew.

Although the Qingyun Continent where their Taixu Sect is located is a bit remote, he has never heard of any immortal cultivating family in the Eighty-one Continent with the surname Weisheng.

When the other elders heard this, their ears pricked up, and they were also very curious.

The eldest lady must be from an extremely powerful family when she acts so arrogantly.
title_en: Chapter 10 The background that cannot be guessed
